description.text: A concept pack of the BW series released on 1 February 2013, with four cards a pack, all of them holo. It collects charming and playful pictures of Pokémon such as Pikachu, Eevee and Piplup, chosen for collectors, along with new Trainers, reprints and secret cards. The cards are numbered to 20, with Super Rare Shaymin-EX, Reshiram, Emolga, Mew-EX and Meloetta-EX beyond that. Many of its cards were reprinted in English in Legendary Treasures in November 2013.
